create_LabelEncoder: create a LabelEncoder to fit target labels and transform them to normalized integer encodings between 0 and n_classes-1
create_LabelBinarizer: create a LabelBinarizer to binarize multi-class labels into binary one-vs-all format for multi-class classification
create_MultiLabelBinarizer: create a MultiLabelBinarizer to transform iterable of iterables into a multilabel binary indicator matrix
build_label_binarize: build a label_binarize call to binarize labels with a fixed set of known class labels in one-vs-all fashion
test_LabelEncoder_inverse_transform: test LabelEncoder inverse_transform to convert encoded integer labels back to original label values
